jobs.description:

 This is a very exciting time for companies at the frontier of AI, and Unloq is scaling fast. We’re building the system of record for business decisions, held to one standard: every answer has to be defensible to a board. You’ll report to our Founding Lead Engineer for the decision engine and work day to day with our founding leads. Most of your week is code, experiments and evaluation runs. The rest is code review, benchmark reviews and pairing.
 🎯 The Role 
 Building and verifying each new client’s golden set: real questions and the correct SQL, checked against ground truth before go-live
 Running every change through the benchmark, and turning every thumbs down into a test, so nothing gets worse
 Making text-to-SQL repeatable, so a re-run gives the same SQL and scores only move when the code does
 Shipping across the engine, from document search and the Semantic Layer to how answers are shown, holding back any chart or table we can’t verify
 🗓️ In your first 90 days , you’ll ship your first fix, take a new client’s golden set to go-live, and turn their thumbs downs into tests.
 👤 Who This Is For 
 1 to 3 years beyond internships, building AI or backend systems
 Strong Python and SQL. Non-negotiable: you can spot a query that runs cleanly and returns the wrong answer
 Something real. At least one LLM, RAG or text-to-SQL project, with a way of measuring whether it worked

 AI-native. Claude Code daily, and you own every line you merge

 💡 You’ll do well here if you can already answer these: 
 A query returns the right columns but sums revenue including returns. How would you catch it automatically?
 Your evaluation score jumped overnight with no code change. What happened?
 📋 Role Basics 
 Role: Full-time AI Engineer, Platform
 Location: Remote, 12pm to 9pm IST core hours
 Compensation: Competitive salary
 Start: ASAP
 Process: a conversation, a short paid SQL exercise, a technical round, and a final with our CTO
 🚀 Why Join Unloq? 
 Learn from the builders. Work day to day with the founding engineers behind the engine.
 Real ownership. Your benchmark decides what ships.
 Modern stack. Claude Code, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS and Azure, Databricks, and Langfuse for evals and tracing.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Research Tooling
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on the Research Tools team, you'll build the infrastructure and applications that enable our researchers to iterate quickly, run complex experiments, and extract insights. This is a full-stack product-engineering role.



You'll work directly with researchers and engineers to deeply understand their workflows, identify bottlenecks, and rapidly ship solutions that multiply their productivity. Whether you're creating platforms for experiment orchestration, developing novel visualization tools for model evaluation, or building abstractions for understanding model behavior at scale, your work will directly accelerate our mission of building frontier AI models.



We're looking for someone who can jump into new problems, quickly develop domain expertise, and independently drive impactful projects from conception to delivery. No prior ML or research experience is required.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and maintain the full-stack applications and infrastructure researchers rely on daily, covering experiment setup, feedback collection, and results analysis.

 - Own complete product areas from user needs through design, implementation, and iteration, setting standards for how to build research applications.

 - Create reusable platforms and tools that speed up new research applications, then prototype, ship, and iterate quickly based on real-world usage.

 - Partner with research teams to turn their workflows and pain points into intuitive interfaces and abstractions that make complex research tasks fast and approachable.




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - You’ve had experience building tools, platforms, or infrastructure for technical users (engineers, researchers, data scientists, analysts, etc.)

 - You’ve shipped full-stack products and owned systems from user interface to storage or services, using technologies such as TypeScript and React alongside Node, Python, or Go.

 - You’ve built dense, data-facing tools such as transcript viewers, diffing systems, review queues, observability products, or operational dashboards—and you have strong opinions about how structured data should be rendered.

 - You have strong product instincts, can identify the right problems to solve, and can move from concept to working prototype with ease.

 - You move quickly under ambiguity, collaborate closely with researchers and domain experts, and take open-ended problems from rough need to reliable product.




APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

 The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.
 The Role CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.
 These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:
 They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.
 They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.
 They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.
 They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.
 They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.
 What you'll do Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.
 How we build Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.
 Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.
 Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.
 Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.
 Recent work Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.
 A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.
 Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.
 Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.
 A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Haskell
jobs.description:
About CircuitHub CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.
 We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.
 The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.
 Overview CircuitHub is primarily built using a combination of Haskell, Nix, and PostgreSQL, deployed to both AWS and bare metal machines. We use a significant amount of open-source technology, and also try and give back where possible (for example, both Rel8 and Fast Downward Haskell bindings ).
 CircuitHub spans a vast problem space. Challenges include computer vision (OpenCV), machine learning (PyTorch), hard optimization problems (Z3/MiniZinc/OR-Tools), and all the normal engineering challenges of building both web-based customer-facing and internal tooling.
 We work on manufacturing execution systems, enterprise resource planning, and robotics. An old video from Haskell Exchange 2019 hints at what we are up to on the robotics side. We have progressed significantly since then!
 These roles are remote (any location), in-person, or hybrid, depending on preference.
 We have offices in South Deerfield - USA, Cambridge, and London, UK.
 Salary depends on the candidate and location, but as guidance in the UK, a likely range is £80k to £125k and in the US $125k to $250k, with additional equity.
 CircuitHub has raised $45M from top-tier VCs and has been going for about ten years. CircuitHub is profitable, with tens of millions in revenue. Small team (CircuitHub is ~50 employees) with tremendous growth opportunity and low risk. We are aiming to 10x capacity through 2027 in both our existing Massachusetts factory and expand into Europe.
   Team/Environment/Role Our R&D team is more than 20 people, with eight engineers working directly on the Haskell code base. We are looking to expand the team significantly this year. We have many exciting problems to solve, from robotic path planning to more conventional web products.
 We are happy to consider candidates without commercial Haskell experience, but your other skills and experience would need to compensate. A possible profile, for instance, would be a professional robotics background with some hobbyist FP experience.
 Conversely, for experienced Haskellers without experience in our domain, we will look for interests that correlate with what we are trying to accomplish. Life is too short to work on something you are not passionate about!
   Location Work remotely, or from one of our offices in the UK (London, Cambridge) or USA (Boston)
 Compensation: £80K – £125K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 
 We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
 We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
 Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
 We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.
 About the role You’ll build backend systems that make our lab programmable. You'll architect data pipelines that process large-scale protein characterization data, build APIs that integrate laboratory instruments and robotics into our software stack, and work closely with scientists and automation engineers to translate complex molecular biology workflows into reliable, scalable software. This is not SaaS slop, you're making physical machines do precise biology with minimal human intervention.
 What we're looking for 
 Strong experience designing and building production backend systems. We use Python and TypeScript on the backend with Postgres, but what matters is that you can architect systems that are reliable and maintainable.
 Experience building data pipelines and processing infrastructure. You'll be handling large volumes of heterogeneous data from physical instruments such as binding kinetics data, enzyme activity measurements, chromatography readings, and turning them into clean, structured datasets.
 Comfortable with API design and systems integration. A big part of this role is making hardware talk to software: connecting instruments, robotics, and scheduling systems into a coherent whole.
 A genuine interest in biology. No background required, but our product is running biology experiments in the physical world and that should excite you.
 High-autonomy, founder mindset. We share context and vision openly. You figure out what matters most and go work on it.
 Pragmatism. You care about solving the problem well, not about the stack or the tools.
 You write code primarily with AI, but you have enough experience writing software without it to know what good code and good architecture look like.
 
 Application deadline 
 We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Implement, test and support well-defined slices of X3 modernisation while developing strong X3 domain knowledge and safe engineering habits.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Strong software engineering experience in modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a proven ability to build, test, deploy, and operate production-grade services.
  
- Solid foundation in software design, object-oriented and distributed systems principles, API-first development, automated testing, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and Agile delivery practices.
  
- Required understanding of distributed systems, including service-to-service communication, event-driven architectures, scalability, resiliency patterns, fault tolerance, asynchronous processing, observability, and data consistency trade-offs.
  
- Experience designing and consuming REST, GraphQL, and event-based integrations, with strong understanding of API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and secure service interactions.
  
- Experience working with relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, migration, and operational considerations.
  
- Familiarity with cloud-native engineering practices, including containers, orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, observability, secure software supply chains, and operational readiness.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Practical experience with modern web application development using React and TypeScript or equivalent modern dynamic UX frameworks, including component-based architectures, responsive and accessible user experiences, state management, browser diagnostics, and automated UI testing.
  
- Ability to learn and work effectively within Sage X3 business processes, metadata-driven architectures, extensibility models, modernization initiatives, and SaaS transformation programs.
  
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed global engineering teams and contribute to technical design discussions and code reviews.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Implement and test service/API contracts and integrations in the assigned discipline; follow secure CI/CD, identity/secrets and telemetry patterns, and contribute compatibility, upgrade and rollback checks. Build hands-on container or IaC skills when required by the owned service, using team-supported paths.

- Commercial ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance experience, including L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL.
  
- React, automated API testing, telemetry, batch processing or migration tooling.
  
- Practical use of AI coding assistants with human …

jobs.description:
**Overview:**

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

**What We're Looking For:**

Responsible for monitoring cloud environments, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring timely escalation of events to maintain system health and performance. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to incident management in a 24x7x365 operational environment.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Diligently observe and interpret cloud monitoring dashboards and alerts
* Resolve basic issues; escalate urgent and complex issues. Know the difference
* Coordinate with internal departments and sometimes with customers
* Be aware of customer SLA’s and escalate issues if cases are taking too long to resolve
* Document all troubleshooting and issue management actions via the electronic case management system
* Schedule resources and arrange work effort to cover weekends and/or on-call shifts to be available to be engaged in response to system-initiated alerts
* Monitoring case backlog to ensure we meet agreed SLAs with customers and internal KPI targets; share regular status reports with stakeholders
* Be able to work in a variety of different shifts, including days, nights, weekends, and holidays to support a 24x7x365 environment. Shifts may fluctuate to meet business and staffing needs

**Key Skills and Competencies:**  

* Experience with Windows, Linux, web services, networking, Data bases, and cloud platforms.
* Understanding of the following monitoring concepts: Infrastructure, systems, and Application health, system availability, latency, performance, and end-to-end monitoring.
* Entry level cloud, network or security certificate from Cisco, Microsoft, AWS, CompTIA, or other well-known vendors.
* Knowledge and experience of SIEM, ELK, PLG, and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes are preferred.
* Cyber Security related Certifications like Security+, SSCP, CCSP, and CEH.
* Knowledge of Markup, query, and scripting languages, including Python, HTML, PromQL, SQL and familiarity with REST API calls, and PowerShell.
* Experience (1+ years) with ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge and Event Management.

**Minimum Education or Equivalent:** Bachelors degree or technical diploma in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field

**Minimum Work Experience:** 2+ years' experience working on an operations style team (NOC, SOC, MOC, etc.) and troubleshooting networking, service desk, operations center and/or supporting cloud based Infrastructure

**Work Environment:** Hybrid

**Safety Sensitive Role:** No

**Travel:** Up to 10%

**Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):** No

jobs.title: Founding Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**About mentblue**

mentblue is a DPIIT-recognised legal education and careers platform. We run practitioner-led certificate courses for law students and young lawyers, provide career services to law schools, and connect students with mentors and recruiters.

**About the role**

We are looking for a founding engineer to own our product workflow end to end. You will work directly with the founders and our product engineering lead to shape features, build them across the stack, deploy them and keep them running in production. AI is central to what we are building next, so you will also lead the LLM-powered features on the platform.

**What you will do**

* Build and ship features end to end with Next.js, React, Node.js and TypeScript, from data model and APIs to interface and deployment.
* Design backend services on MongoDB and Redis, including background jobs, email and WhatsApp notifications, and payment flows.
* Build AI features with LLM APIs: structured outputs, retrieval over documents, prompt design and evaluation, and checks that keep outputs reliable.
* Deploy and run services on AWS with Docker, with CI/CD, monitoring and logging.
* Take ownership of technical decisions and of the quality of what you ship.

**What we are looking for**

* At least 2 years of professional software development experience.
* A record of building products end to end and owning the full product workflow.
* Production experience with Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, React, MongoDB, Redis, REST APIs, AWS and Docker.
* Knowledge of AI and LLMs is necessary. You should have built something with an LLM API and understand where models fail.
* Comfort working in a small team without detailed specifications, with clear written communication.

**Good to have**

* Payment gateway integration (Razorpay or similar).
* Queues or event-driven systems (BullMQ, SQS or similar).
* Experience with marketplace, education or legal products.

**Job details**

Full-time and remote. Salary as per experience.

Application Question(s):

* Have you built and shipped a feature using an LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or similar)? Briefly describe what it did and link to it if you can.
* What is your notice period?
* What are your current and expected annual CTC (in lakhs per annum)?
* Please share your GitHub profile link.

Experience:

* Node.js: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
Backend Engineer Junior (1-3 Years) Mumbai, India Full-time, on-site Apply for this role Overview 
 Unico Connect is seeking a Backend Engineer to build and ship production backends for client web and mobile products. The role spans API design, database modelling, third-party integrations, and the discipline of writing tested, observable code. The position is well suited to early-career backend engineers with shipped production work in Node.js or Python and a willingness to deepen across the full backend stack.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Build REST and GraphQL APIs using Node.js (NestJS or Fastify) or Python (FastAPI or Django)
 Design and maintain PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB schemas with appropriate indexing
 Integrate third-party APIs such as Stripe, Twilio, SendGrid, and Razorpay
 Write unit and integration tests; target 80%+ coverage on critical paths
 Implement authentication, authorisation, and rate limiting using established patterns
 Deploy services to GCP or AWS through CI/CD pipelines
 Pair with Senior Backend Engineers on architecture decisions and code reviews
 Participate in incident response rotations for owned services
 Maintain technical documentation for owned services and integrations
 Contribute to internal backend templates, generators, and shared libraries
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 1-3 years of backend engineering with shipped production work
 Strong Node.js with TypeScript or Python (FastAPI or Django)
 Production experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB
 Working knowledge of Redis and at least 1 message queue (BullMQ, RabbitMQ, or SQS)
 Familiarity with Docker and at least 1 cloud (GCP or AWS)
 Solid testing fundamentals including unit, integration, and contract tests
 Comfort with Git, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipelines
 Working understanding of HTTP, REST, and basic distributed systems concepts
 Excellent written communication for pull request descriptions and design docs
 Preferred Qualifications 
 GraphQL exposure (Apollo, Pothos, gqlgen)
 Microservices with gRPC
 Hands-on with Kubernetes basics
 Experience with serverless platforms (Cloud Run, Lambda)
 Open-source contributions to backend libraries
 AI Tools Proficiency
